rows.notes: CE predicted_resource_valid() (cache/predicted_resources.c, SHA-256 pinned) on a tag table keyed by tag_index: validity flips exactly as the table dictates. Host evidence only.

test_portal_back_front_swap_changes_read_record: swapping back/front of one portal in retail bloodgulch makes CE's structure_visibility traversal read the swapped ends; asserted against mutated bytes. Visible-cluster set (VIS) recorded but not asserted: needs portal-plane geometry not modelled.
test_cluster_unused_bytes_retained_and_not_read: poisoning the three longs leaves visible set, portal reads, hulls and cluster stats identical; bytes_same=1; grep finds no reader in CE source.

test_ce_close_and_closed_follow_leaf_map_members: leaf_map_close_portal() and leaf_map_leaf_is_closed() (structures/leaf_map.c:472-530) compiled verbatim over a SYNTHETIC leaf_map (3 leaves, 2 portals). Oracle sequence asserted: close sets designators, is_closed follows them; mutating a leaf's designator list or a portal's leaf index makes CE hit match_assert line 673. Synthetic, not retail.
Same mutation as cluster_portals: CE reads the back/front pair from the mutated cluster_indices, asserted against mutated bytes.

test_portal_vertices_feed_portal_hull: +500 on portal 0's first vertex; the HANDOFF record of what CE passes to portal_hull_from_points (hull math stubbed in host) shows that x, same count, other portals unchanged.

test_ce_precache_walks_cluster_list_and_records_sinks: predicted_resources_precache() and predicted_resource_valid() compiled verbatim (cache/predicted_resources.c) over a synthetic cluster block; stubbed texture/sound sinks record calls. Mutations: sound entry tag -> bitmap group (sound sink dropped), bitmap index out of range (dropped), block count 4->2 (tail dropped). Synthetic.
test_cluster_subclusters_count_drives_surface_set: subcluster count 0 gives sub=0 and the empty surface-set hash (pinned hash_sorted([])).
test_cluster_portal_index_order_changes_read_and_hash: swapping two listed portal indices changes CE's READ order and the portal hash to the Python portal_fnv oracle.
Entries of cluster.portal_indices are structure_portal_index shorts; the swap test asserts CE reads the mutated values in order.

test_mirror_points_handed_to_portal_hull: synthetic mirror (3 points) appended to retail bloodgulch cluster 0 (inside its PVS). Host gate relaxed by C4_ALLOW_MIRRORS in the instrumented copy only. CE's structure_visibility_find_mirror hands mirror->points to portal_hull_from_points: count and first point match mutations (x 1->50, count 3->2). Hull math stubbed; shader/environment path after the hull not driven.

test_sound_unused_bytes_retained_and_not_read: zero-read shown by grep (only structure_bsp_definitions.h names sound_unused); poisoning the six longs leaves visible set, reads, hulls, cluster stats identical, bytes_same=1. Offset from the instrumented host LAYOUT line (host struct copy of CE definition).

test_ce_deafening_lookup_follows_background_sound_entry: scenario_location_deafening() (scenario/scenario.c:525-553, background_sound lookup 538-548) compiled verbatim over a synthetic palette; changing a palette entry's background_sound flips the result for exactly that cluster. NOT driven: the selected background-sound tag path (scenario.c:1398, game_sound.c:823-861).
